scope: all saved valid participant instances together, original submission paths
duration: complete pytest subprocess wall time, including interpreter startup and collection
manual_recollection_policy: user-requested full-cohort replacement; delete earlier timing datasets after the new complete run is verified
execution_order: serial in ascending participant number; prepare and verify all snapshots before timing; no concurrent metric collection
pilot_selection_basis: 7-instance suite and both 8-instance suites; frozen before timing
comparability: Phase 1 timer and estimator reused; Phase 2 uses original files instead of isolated function files. Direct phase differences also include SUT, task and layout changes.
global_warmup_policy: none; retain one baseline and three participant warmups before fifteen formal measurements
